scene: The drone projects three transit portals across the vibrant tiled plaza.
picture: Flat side view along a tiled plaza. The Pacific Islander girl stands left of centre holding the open drone, sketchbook tucked under her arm. On the far left sits a clear pneumatic tube pod. To her right floats an anchored giant bubble lift. On the far right stands a brass revolving door lift.
shown: a glass pneumatic tube pod sitting open on the far left
a giant shimmering soap bubble anchored to a platform on the right
a glowing brass revolving door spinning on the far right
